label: The reference template defines the contract (1-2 sentence intro, OVERVIEW with Purpose/When to Use/Core Principle, six frontmatter fields) but duplicates its own when-to-create guidance in Section 1 and Section 3, modelling the defect it forbids.
The hub ROUTER.md violates the asset template's related-last rule: RELATED RESOURCES at line 218 precedes the machine-readable router (227), HOW TO READ THIS (441) and MACHINE ROUTER (450).
runner-contract.md opens with OVERVIEW AND CLI and immediately shows a code fence, so the overview section has no overview, no Purpose and no When to Use.
stack-detection.md omits the template-required Purpose and When to Use subsections, opening its OVERVIEW with Core Principle and a Surfaces table.

OVERVIEW subheading order diverges across four sibling references: phase-detection Purpose/When/Core, workflow-implement Purpose/Core/When, workflow-verify Purpose/Iron Law/When, code-quality-standards Purpose/Core/When.
